business.name: Hush Home Cleaning
business.responseTime: We confirm every booking by text within two hours, during office hours.

hero.headline: Come home to a house that's already done.
hero.lede: Police-checked home cleaners across Brisbane's inner south. The same person every visit, a price you can see right now, and nothing to sign.

worries.q: Will it be the same person each time?
worries.a: Yes. You get one regular cleaner, plus a named backup who has already been to your home, for when they're on leave. Last year 94% of our visits were done by the customer's regular cleaner.

worries.q: Can I trust them in my house?
worries.a: Every cleaner is a Hush employee, not a subcontractor. Each one has a current national police check, two references we've actually called, and two weeks of paid training before they work alone.

worries.q: Do I need to be home?
worries.a: Most of our customers aren't. Leave a key in a lockbox, give us a door code, or keep a key with us. We text when we arrive and again when we've locked up.
Tell us within 48 hours and we'll come back and redo it, free. We don't argue about whether it counts.

steps.title: Get your price
steps.text: Choose your home size and how often. The number you see here is the number on your invoice.

steps.title: Pick your days
steps.text: Tell us which days suit and how we'll get in. We confirm by text, usually within two hours.

steps.title: Meet your cleaner
steps.text: The first visit runs a little longer while we bring the house up to a proper baseline.

steps.title: Then it just happens
steps.text: Same person, same day, same standard. Skip or pause any visit by replying to a text.

guarantees.title: Free re-clean within 48 hours
guarantees.text: If anything on the checklist isn't right, tell us within 48 hours and we'll come back and fix it at no cost.

guarantees.title: Bond back guarantee
guarantees.text: End of lease cleans come with 72 hours of cover. If your agent flags something we were meant to clean, we return and sort it out, free.

pillars.title: Employees, not subcontractors
pillars.text: Every cleaner is on our payroll with award wages, super and WorkCover. It's why they stay for years, and why you get the same person.

pillars.title: Police-checked every two years
pillars.text: A national police check before anyone starts, renewed every two years, not just once on hiring.

pillars.title: $10 million public liability
pillars.text: And one simple rule: if we break something, you hear it from us first.

pillars.title: Two weeks of training
pillars.text: New cleaners shadow a senior cleaner for two weeks before they're ever sent out alone.

pillars.title: Safe around kids and pets
pillars.text: Plant-based products by default. Tell us about allergies and we'll use whatever you prefer.

pillars.title: We bring everything
pillars.text: Vacuum, mops, cloths and products. Nothing of yours gets used unless you ask.

founder.name: Leonie Park
founder.note: I cleaned houses for six years before I started Hush, and the thing customers told me most wasn't that the last company did a bad job. It was that they never knew who was coming. So that's the whole idea: one person who knows your house, who you've actually met. Everything else — the checklists, the guarantee, the prices on the website — is just us making it easy to trust that person.

faq.q: How do you work out the price?
faq.a: By the number of bedrooms and bathrooms, the type of clean, and any extras. Regular visits get a discount for coming more often. The quote on our prices page is exactly what we charge.

faq.q: What do I need to provide?
faq.a: Nothing. Your cleaner brings the vacuum, mops, cloths and all the products. If you'd like us to use something of yours, just leave it out with a note.

faq.q: How long does a clean take?
faq.a: A regular clean on a three bedroom home is usually two and a half to three and a half hours. Longer jobs get two cleaners, so they're finished sooner.

faq.q: Can I skip or reschedule a visit?
faq.a: Yes, with 48 hours' notice. Reply to your reminder text and it's done. There's no fee for skipping.

faq.q: What happens if my cleaner is sick?
faq.a: Your named backup comes instead. They'll have been to your home before, so nobody new turns up unannounced.

faq.q: Do you clean homes with pets?
faq.a: All the time. Let us know what pets you have so your cleaner knows who they're meeting, and whether anyone needs to stay inside.
We charge the card on file the day after each clean, so you've had a chance to check the work first. No deposits for regular or deep cleans.
